guide.who: Parking from 2 a.m. to 6 a.m. for residents of older buildings near downtown La Grange and the West End.

bullets.text: The Village makes a limited number of public parking spaces available to residents of older buildings near the downtown.
Permit holders must park only in the spaces designated as available for overnight parking. No specific lots or parking spaces are assigned.
There are two types of resident overnight parking permits:
items: West End permits are valid in Lots 13 and 15 only.
Central Business District (CBD) permits are valid in Lots 2, 5, 11 and 12 and the Village Hall Garage.

bullets.text: Permit holders are entitled to park between 2 a.m. and 6 a.m. Overnight parking is allowed by permit only.
Most Village public parking is time limited from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. and not time limited after 8 p.m.
You must meet all of the following:
items: Live within the eligible areas near the CBD or West End business districts. Address verification is required at application and renewal.
Live in a building built prior to 1993.
Residents of single family detached homes are only eligible if their property has no on-site parking.

bullets.text: Maximum of 2 permits per household / residential unit. You may register a primary and an alternate vehicle on one permit, but are entitled to only one parking space per permit.

guide.who: Parking all day and overnight, for residents of older buildings near downtown La Grange and the West End that have no other parking.

bullets.text: The Village makes a limited number of public parking spaces available to residents of older buildings near the downtown that have no parking on their private properties.
There are two types of resident 24 hr. permits: Central Business District (CBD) and West End.

Permits are issued for a specific lot. Permit holders may park anywhere within their lot during the day; between 2 a.m. and 6 a.m. they must park within the designated overnight parking areas. No specific parking spaces are assigned.
If you cannot find parking in your lot, overflow parking is available on Levels 2 and 3 of the Village Hall Garage.
Permit holders are entitled to park any time with no time limits.
Most Village public parking is time limited from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. and not time limited after 8 p.m.
You must meet all of the following:
items: Live within the eligible areas near the CBD or West End business districts. Address verification is required at application and renewal.
Live in a building built prior to 1993.
Live in a residential building with no on-site parking, or in a mixed use (commercial & residential) building.
Residents of single family detached homes are only eligible if their property has no on-site parking.

bullets.text: Maximum of 2 permits per household / residential unit. You may register a primary and an alternate vehicle on one permit, but are entitled to only one parking space per permit.
Vehicles must move at least every 5 days. No tarped vehicles.
No commercial vehicles, or vehicles with logos in excess of one square foot.

seeAlso.label: See the overnight parking areas
seeAlso.text: Between 2 a.m. and 6 a.m. you must park in the designated overnight areas.

guide.who: Daytime parking for Metra commuters and Lyons Township High School students.

bullets.text: Commuter permit holders are entitled to park 6 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday–Friday.
LTHS student permit holders are entitled to park 6 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday–Friday, during the school year only.
Permits are issued for a specific lot or zone. Permit holders may park anywhere within their lot/zone — no specific parking spaces are assigned.

If you cannot find parking in your lot/zone, overflow parking is available in any nearby time-limited space. You must contact the Parking Enforcement Division at (708) 352-2131 to advise them of the need for temporary alternate parking.
Permits for Lot 13 require verification of commuter status at application and renewal.
You may register a primary and an alternate vehicle on one permit, but are entitled to only one parking space per permit.

guide.who: Parking for people who work downtown — Central Business District (CBD) and West End Business District (WBD) employee permits.

bullets.text: Permit holders must park only in the spaces designated as available for employee parking. No specific parking spaces are assigned.
There are two types of employee parking permits:
items: CBD permits are valid anywhere within Lot 2, in designated spaces only in Lot 5 and on-street on Calendar Ave. and Harris Ave., and on Levels 2 and 3 of the Village Hall Garage.
WBD permits are valid anywhere in Lot 15, as well as designated on-street spaces on Waiola Ave. and Hillgrove Ave.

bullets.text: Permit holders are entitled to park with no time limit between 6 a.m. and 8 p.m.
Most Village public parking is time limited from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. and not time limited after 8 p.m. Overnight parking (2 a.m. to 6 a.m.) is prohibited.
You must be an employee of a business within the eligible CBD or WBD area. Proof of employment is required at application and renewal.
Maximum of 1 permit per person. You may register a primary and an alternate vehicle on one permit, but are entitled to only one parking space.
